title: Microsoft Purview: Diagnostics open to Compliance Administrator, Security Administrator and Organization Management
summary: The briefing accurately reports the roadmap and distinguishes it from the diagnostic-specific permissions on Microsoft Learn. The role-group path and PowerShell call are supported; minor corrections concern a missing path heading, the licensing model's understatement of the general licence requirement, and an Entra-role checklist step without a controls-table row.
